ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: The visible fluke surface is dominated by low-intensity (black) pixels with approximately 3-5% distribution of high-intensity (white) localized clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary dark contiguous region across both lobes. High-contrast white focal clusters are localized at the far-left distal tip and scattered as isolated points across the mid-latitudes of both the left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 68 degrees and a vertical bounding-box depth occupying 1/6th of the total vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular linear boundary; left lobe displays high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations; right lobe displays low-frequency, high-amplitude jagged peaks and valleys approaching the tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-lateral concave curve originating from the median notch, transitioning to a sharp convex terminal curve at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed cluster of circular high-contrast white pixel groups located on the far-left tip; sparse individual circular white spots distributed across the central-left and outer-right lobe regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two prominent, parallel, diagonal high-intensity linear tracks located on the upper-right lobe; several faint, shorter vertical linear disruptions visible on the upper-left lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct parallel rake marks on the upper right fluke lobe and significant accumulation of high-contrast circular clusters (calcification or scarring) on the far left tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Dynamic high-intensity pixel spray and splash pattern visible at the lower horizontal intersection of the fluke and the water surface.
